items.question: What technologies does Rachaphol Plookaom work with?
items.answer: Rachaphol Plookaom builds frontends with React, Next.js, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS, backends with Go (Fiber), Node.js and Python (Django), and mobile apps with Flutter and Dart, using PostgreSQL for data.

items.question: How does a biology background help in software development?
items.answer: Training in Biological Sciences taught Rachaphol Plookaom to treat problems as experiments: form a hypothesis, change one variable, measure the result. The same loop drives debugging, performance work and product decisions.

items.question: What has Rachaphol Plookaom built?
items.answer: Selected projects include Perd Wai, a café launch simulator; Layer 3D, a website for a Bangkok 3D-printing studio; and Cafe’nMe, a café point-of-sale application with shop administration and LINE membership. Other public work includes Rob Baan, a wildlife dex, and ByteTrack, a calorie-tracking frontend demo. The full list is on the Projects page.

items.question: Is Rachaphol Plookaom available for freelance work?
items.answer: Yes. Rachaphol Plookaom is open to freelance projects and full-time roles. The fastest way to get in touch is by email at {email} or through the contact form on this site.

items.question: Where is Rachaphol Plookaom based?
items.answer: Rachaphol Plookaom is based in Bangkok, Thailand (UTC+7).
